Hi, I'm Owen. I'm a documentary and historical linguist, specializing in languages of Eastern Indonesia, especially Timor and southern Maluku.
I am the managing editor of Oceanic Linguistics and on the Advisory Board of the Language & Culture Unit (UBB) in Kupang. 

I also do linguistic consultancy, especially in the areas of data processing, orthography development, and linguistic cartography.
You can read more about my services [here](consulting.qmd) and find maps [here](maps.qmd).
